SparkR / SPARKR-192
Add ability to apply a schema to an existing RRDD
Issue Type: Sub-task
Assignee: Unassigned
Created: 03/Feb/15 11:32 AM
Priority: Major
Reporter: Shivaram Venkataraman

This is the reverse of the task in SPARKR-187 where we take an existing RRRD and apply a schema to convert it to a DataFrame

This change should include support for specifying a schema using common R types such as "character", "int" etc.
